title: Free Human site events compare against the Space's own day, not the UTC day

verify.note: Fails before the fix: freeHumanToday does not exist and today comes from toISOString.

detail: freeHumanUpcoming and freeHumanOccurrences used now.toISOString().slice(0,10), the UTC day, against stored wall-clock dates. After about 5pm Pacific the day flips and the evening's gatherings leave the upcoming list and the Calendar block hours early (same class as SCAN-1037 and SCAN-1126). Fixed for the Free Human helpers with the Space's zone (America/Los_Angeles). Still open under this row: the 'today' mark in the Nocturne, Temple, Network and Roles blocks (midnight.tsx:130, network-kit.tsx:131, temple-kit.tsx:152, roles.tsx:184, free-human-calendar.tsx:92), which need the Space zone passed in; row stays open until those use it.
